projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Rust
description: Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Rust, all in one 51Degrees cloud service. Device Detection and IP Intelligence also run on-premise. Device Detection is a User-Agent and Client Hints parser that finds the device, browser, operating system, and crawlers, an alternative to UAParser.js, DeviceAtlas, and WURFL. IP Intelligence gives IP geolocation to an approximate city level location, an alternative to MaxMind and IPinfo. Includes a 51Did reader.
